approval: Ok, tu peux intégrer et passer au lot suivant s'il y en a un.
user_request: Pour l'organisation de blocus, plusieurs bateaux qui forment une chaîne. Ne change que l'organisation du blocus.
scope: Only blockade artwork revised. Landing launch and coastal battery preserved byte-for-byte. Preview only; no runtime bindings or statistics changed.
palette_basis: Existing native functional palettes: blue marine_capacity, copper-brown supplies_navy, red average_damage_navy. These are three functions, not three upgrade tiers.
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE miniature naval designer FUNCTION MODIFICATION UI icon for Victoria 3, not a full illustration.
Input images: Image 1 is ONLY a STYLE AND FUNCTION PALETTE reference of native marine/supply/damage glyphs. Image 2 is ONLY a rendering-style reference of the native equipment icons. Do not reproduce the contact-sheet background or labels.
Style: compact painted embossed metal glyph, restrained highlights, broad clean shaded facets, thin dark bevel outline. Coherent three-quarter slightly-above view. A few large shapes, very readable at 32 pixels. Entire subject visible with padding.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha, including gaps. Artwork itself opaque except edge antialiasing. No external shadow, glow, halo, haze or vignette.
No text, labels, numerals, frame, people, photographic scene, modern machines, motor propulsion, sea background, tiny rigging or sprawling diorama. This is ONE function emblem, NOT three progression tiers.
Subject: ONE open historical wooden ROWING LAUNCH for landing troops, viewed three-quarter from above, with a wide curved hull, three broad transverse benches and TWO thick long OARS crossed above the open hull. Clear compact silhouette of a small rowboat and crossed oars, not a full sailing ship. No sail or mast, no ropes, no crate. All wood and metal rendered in ONE cool steel BLUE palette matching the marine_capacity glyph at left in Image 1. Broad pale-blue highlights and navy-blue recesses.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE compact Victoria 3 naval designer FUNCTION MODIFICATION icon, readable at 32 pixels.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and style/palette reference.
Change ONLY the representation of naval blockade: REMOVE the entire physical metal chain. Replace the single sailboat by THREE simplified early wooden SAILBOATS forming a tight continuous naval cordon, aligned end-to-end across a shallow diagonal. The three boats themselves form a symbolic CHAIN OF SHIPS, with no literal links, ropes or chain anywhere. All three hulls and square sails must remain visibly distinct, not merged. Use a compact stepped diagonal composition, slight overlap only if necessary, so the group fits a nearly square icon. Each boat has one simple mast and one broad square sail; minimize rigging, ribs and tiny details.
Preserve the original warm copper-brown BRONZE monochrome palette, painted embossed miniature metal glyph finish, broad clean facets, bright bevel highlights, thin dark outline and coherent three-quarter slightly-above perspective. ALL hulls and sails same bronze material. Transparent background and gaps, opaque artwork except edge antialiasing; no added scenery, sea, harbor, labels, text, flags, border, glow, haze or external shadow. No engine, no modern ship, no people. Not a realistic naval scene or technical plan. One unified function icon showing a cordon of three distinct sailing vessels.

Compact integrated emblem: large straight cannon barrel pointing outward, minimal bow rail and a single shore rock. Cannon clearly sits on the ship deck, not on a land fortress. Coherent perspective with straight cylindrical barrel and axle; no curved cannon, no massive gun, no modern artillery, no smoke or explosion. Entire emblem in ONE muted terracotta-RED / copper-red palette matching average_damage_navy at right in Image 1, with warm pale reddish highlights, burgundy recesses; no blue sea or natural brown wood.

qa.visual_inspection: Original and contact sheet inspected at large size, 64px and 32px. Three distinct sailboats form a diagonal naval cordon without any physical chain. Bronze palette and embossed style retained. Landing and coastal battery masters unchanged by verified SHA-256. No runtime export or gameplay change.
qa.limitations: Generated partially transparent pixels are preserved without alpha retouch. Simplified function emblem, not a historical ship plan. Native bronze functional palette retained.

integration_note: Three approved originals integrated as native 120px DDS with seven mipmaps. Four icon bindings only: one shared landing launch for cog and caravel, bronze blockade v2, red coastal battery. Statistics, costs, technologies and fleets unchanged. Narrow baseline passed, 190 registry exports rebuild exactly. Only aor_galley_boarding_spur still uses a generic native icon. No engine test.
